capabilities: add code-editor-style default hotkeys to the editor
insert, delete, duplicate and copy lines via shortcuts
select words, occurrences, lines and expand selection to quotes or brackets
transform selection case (uppercase, lowercase, title case, toggle)
configure each shortcut and list-prefix behavior in settings
extras: The README states the project is in a maintenance state: bugs are not fixed regularly, though pull requests and critical bugs are still accepted. It also documents default-shortcut conflicts (Ctrl+Enter with open link under cursor, Ctrl+L with toggle checkbox) and Live Preview limitations for undo/redo with multiple cursors.
intentEvidence: adds keyboard shortcuts (hotkeys) commonly found in code editors such as Visual Studio Code or Sublime Text
problem: Obsidian's editor lacks the default keybindings that developers are used to from code editors like VS Code or Sublime Text.
summary: Adds Visual Studio Code and Sublime Text style keyboard shortcuts for line, cursor, selection, navigation and case-transform commands.
